subject: bane_nightmare
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.

context.description_en: Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely. Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
context.description_zh: 让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
notes_en: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
notes_zh: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。

subject: dark_willow_shadow_realm
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.

context.description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
notes_en: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
notes_zh: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。

scepter_loc.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter_loc.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

subject: dazzle_nothl_projection
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether.
戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。

context.description_en: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
context.description_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：剧毒之触带有妖术效果；薄葬结束时会治疗；暗影波的冷却时间变短。效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
notes_en: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
notes_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。

subject: earth_spirit_stone_caller
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。
Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.

context.description_en: Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
context.description_zh: 在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得%attack_damage_per_stone%%%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得%attack_damage_per_stone_used%%%攻击力加成，持续%buff_duration%秒（无法叠加）。

subject: invoker_tornado
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。
Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_OVERSHOOT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECT_KEYBIND

context.description_en:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于雷元素等级。滞空时间取决于冰元素等级。落地伤害取决于雷元素的等级。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
notes_zh: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。

scepter_loc.en: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
scepter_loc.zh: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于冰的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每%twister_tick_rate%秒在%twister_radius%范围内基于雷的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）

subject: juggernaut_omni_slash
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。
无敌斩期间可以使用物品。
Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

context.description_en:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: You can use items during Omnislash.
notes_zh: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

subject: manta
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 1 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

abilities.title: Mirror Image
abilities.description:
Creates 2 images of your hero that last 18 seconds. 

Melee images deal 33% damage, while Ranged images deal 25%. Illusions take 300% damage. 

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

context.notes:
Has a 0.1 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

subject: meepo_petrify
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s.

context.description_en: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh: 挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续%duration%秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的%hp_restore%%%。被缠绕时无法施放。驱散类型：弱驱散

subject: naga_siren_mirror_image
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.

context.description_en:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.
notes_zh: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。

subject: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled.

context.description_en: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
context.description_zh: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
notes_en: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
notes_zh: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。

shard_loc.en: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
shard_loc.zh: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。

subject: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。
Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_SILENCE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AFFECTED_BY_MUTE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IS_FAKE_ITEM | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DONT_RESUME_ATTACK | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES

context.description_en: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
context.description_zh: 使用：比例失真制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
notes_zh: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

subject: ringmaster_the_box
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed.

context.description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
context.description_zh: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。

scepter_loc.en: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

subject: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

context.description_en: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
context.description_zh: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
notes_en: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.
notes_zh: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。

subject: techies_minefield_sign
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 在指定地点放置警示牌，使作用范围内的感应地雷为无敌状态，并且造成的伤害增加%bonus_mine_damage_pct%%%。
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%%% more damage.

context.description_en: Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%%% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.When an enemy Hero walks within %trigger_radius% units of a minefield sign, the %aura_radius% units area around the sign will become a minefield for %minefield_duration% seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.
context.description_zh: 在指定地点放置警示牌，使作用范围内的感应地雷为无敌状态，并且造成的伤害增加%bonus_mine_damage_pct%%%。同一时间只能存在一个标识。持续%lifetime%秒。敌方英雄进入标识的%trigger_radius%范围内时标识附近整个%aura_radius%范围变成一片雷区，持续%minefield_duration%秒。敌方单位在区域内移动都会受到伤害。雷区持续时间结束后标识会被摧毁。

subject: terrorblade_reflection
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area.
Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
倒影为无敌状态。

context.description_en: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
context.description_zh: 恐怖利刃映出目标区域内所有敌方英雄的黑暗倒影对其进行反制，目标在短时间内将被自身倒影攻击，移动速度和攻击速度都会降低。倒影为无敌状态。
notes_en: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.
notes_zh: 无法以倒影的幻象为目标，并且幻象为无敌，减速效果被移除后幻象将被摧毁。
倒影只会攻击该技能指定的目标。

subject: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: 2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。
2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.

context.description_en: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
context.description_zh: 维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
notes_en: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
notes_zh: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

shard_loc.en: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.  Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
shard_loc.zh: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。

subject: visage_summon_familiars
definition: 暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
evidence: While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.
在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。

context.description_en:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
context.description_zh:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
notes_en: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
notes_zh: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

subject: bloodseeker_sanguivore
